_comment: VARIETYSTRUCTUREPLAN Band 2 (D4/§5) — layers a little tier-1 Inferium Essence onto the Abandoned Inferium Plot's chest. Inert without Mystical Agriculture: AddDropModifier resolves the id via Lookup.hasItem and adds nothing when absent. Gate-safe: inferium essence is the mod's cheapest, renewable, mob-droppable base material, never a seed / higher-tier essence / prosperity block.
